findings.why_it_is_a_defect: The unstructured task is not retained/cancelled; overlapping refreshes can publish stale completions and retain the view model.
findings.recommended_change: Store/cancel on replacement and teardown and gate every completion by current request generation.

findings.why_it_is_a_defect: Cancellation and all failures are silently converted into an empty list, overwriting data and hiding failure.
findings.recommended_change: Handle cancellation separately and represent failure explicitly or preserve last-known messages.
findings.authority_or_scope_note: Product error contract is not supplied.

controls_not_defects: MessageRepository actor isolation is not a defect; OwnedMessageViewModel is the stated control.
unknowns: Retry implementation, transport cancellation, Sendability, and error presentation are unspecified.
